in_marathi.name: Devak
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devak हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devak is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Deva’, meaning 'god'. The suffix ‘k’ signifies ‘gift from god’. This name is given to a child who is believed to be a divine gift.
